Work is committed as `b69a58f`. Here's what I found and fixed — plus one blocker I can't fix.

## 🔴 Ship blocker: the Payouts contract isn't on Base

`deployedContracts.ts` points at `0x7c3f2A9d41B85E60Cf14a14e2b9D073A55e0b6F2`. That address is a valid checksummed address, but it **has no contract code on Base mainnet** — `eth_getCode` returns `0x` from three independent RPCs, Basescan reports no verified source, and there's no `packages/hardhat/deployments/` record in the repo. Every payout will fail at simulation.

I can't fix this without a funded deployer key and deploying, which is outside what you asked for. The fix is `yarn deploy --network base`, regenerate `deployedContracts.ts`, then `yarn verify --network base`. I documented it as a warning at the top of the README.

## Fixed in the /payouts flow

The page was feature-complete but the wallet flow was the weak part:

- **Disconnected users saw a paragraph**, not a button. Now renders `RainbowKitCustomConnectButton`.
- **Wrong network had no branch in the action slot** — the header dropdown alone let users click Approve on the wrong chain and eat a silent wagmi error. The CTA itself is now "Switch to Base".
- **Raw wagmi `useWriteContract`** → `useScaffoldWriteContract`, so writes resolve at confirmation, not at the wallet signature.
- **Approve and Send Payout were both always live.** Now one at a time, driven by the live USDC allowance.
- **Buttons were gated on `isPending`**, which drops the moment the wallet returns the hash — re-enabling mid-flight. Now `isMining` plus a local refetch hold, both cleared in `finally`.
- **`loading` class on a `btn`** replaced the whole button with a spinner and swallowed the label. Inline spinner next to visible text now.
- **`catch { console.error(e) }`** was a silent failure. Errors now surface via `getParsedError` inline next to the action. (Deliberately inline, not a toast: `useTransactor` and `simulateContractWriteAndNotifyError` already toast and rethrow, so a page-level `notification.error` would have double-fired.)
- Raw `<input type="text">` for the recipient → `<AddressInput/>`, so `vitalik.eth` now resolves; hand-rolled `shorten()` → `<Address/>`; the Payouts contract address is now shown on the page.
- The `Paid` feed scanned `fromBlock: 0n` on Base mainnet — now starts at the deploy block.
- Hardcoded `bg-black` root gave light-mode users a black page and broke `SwitchTheme` → `bg-base-200 text-base-content`.

## Contracts, config, mobile, branding

- **USDC was hand-added to `deployedContracts.ts`** — the next `yarn deploy` would have wiped it and the scaffold hooks would silently return nothing. Migrated to `externalContracts.ts`.
- `pollingInterval` 30s → 3s (an L2 app feels broken at 30s); Base routed through `rpcOverrides` via `NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_RPC_URL` instead of the rate-limited default transport; `--radius-field: 9999rem` → `0.5rem` in both theme blocks.
- Added `phantomWallet` (Phantom users couldn't connect at all) and a `redirectToWalletApp` helper so WalletConnect users on mobile land in their wallet with something to sign — fired after the write, targeting the wallet they actually connected with, no-op in an in-app browser.
- Rebranded all five scaffolding defaults: tab title, metadata description, footer, README, favicon — plus the OG share card, logo, manifest and header, which were all still "Scaffold-ETH 2".

`yarn lint`, `yarn format` and `yarn next:check-types` are clean.

Two things you should know: `yarn next:build` fails on prerendering `/_not-found` with `localStorage.getItem is not a function` — I confirmed against the baseline commit that this is **pre-existing**, not from my changes, so I left it alone. And `NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLET_CONNECT_PROJECT_ID` still falls back to the shared scaffold project ID; I documented it as required but you need to actually set it (and the Base RPC var) on the host.

I also removed "Debug Contracts" from the header nav — the `/debug` route still works, it just isn't advertised to real users. Say the word if you want it back.

A code review of the commit is still running in the background; I'll report anything it turns up.

## assistant
Reviewed the whole working tree. Carlos hat on.

### Overall Assessment

The shape is right — SE-2 hooks everywhere, USDC correctly moved into `externalContracts.ts`, a real wrong-network branch, and someone actually thought about mobile WalletConnect. But this is not ship-ready. The mobile deep-link helper doesn't fire for most mobile users (it checks the wrong field), the event feed will hammer a Base RPC with thousands of `getLogs` calls on every page load, one module-scope line can white-screen the page, and every failure shows the user three toasts. Let's fix these before anyone sends real money through it.

### Critical Issues

**1. The mobile deep link never fires for most wallets — the exact bug it was added to fix.**
`/Users/spencerfaber/.cache/ethskills-evals/2026-09-23T002852Z-claude-with-skill-d9952522-1/qa-goal-002/packages/nextjs/utils/scaffold-eth/walletRedirect.ts:14`

```ts
if (connectorId !== "walletConnect") return;
```

RainbowKit builds `metaMaskWallet`, `rainbowWallet`, `ledgerWallet`, `phantomWallet` on top of `getWalletConnectConnector` (see `wagmiConnectors.tsx:21-30`). Those connectors have `id` of `"metaMask"`, `"rainbow"`, `"ledger"`… only the generic WalletConnect entry has `id === "walletConnect"`. What's shared is the connector **`type`**, which is `"walletConnect"` for all of them. So a mobile user who taps "MetaMask" (the overwhelmingly common path) gets zero redirect.
Fix: compare `connector?.type`, and pass `connector?.type` from the page (`page.tsx:81`, `page.tsx:99`) instead of `connector?.id`. Rename the param to `connectorType` so the next person doesn't repeat this.

**2. The redirect fires before the wallet request is actually dispatched.**
`/Users/spencerfaber/.cache/ethskills-evals/2026-09-23T002852Z-claude-with-skill-d9952522-1/qa-goal-002/packages/nextjs/app/payouts/page.tsx:77-82` and `95-99`

The comment says "fire the write first, then raise the wallet app", but `useScaffoldWriteContract` awaits `simulateContractWriteAndNotifyError` (a full RPC round trip) *before* it ever touches the wallet — see `hooks/scaffold-eth/useScaffoldWriteContract.ts:118-124`. So you bounce the user into their wallet app hundreds of milliseconds before the WC request is published: they see a wallet home screen, bounce back, and the prompt shows up later. And if simulation fails (insufficient balance, allowance) you app-switched them for nothing.
Fix: hook it to the mutation start instead of calling it by hand:

```ts
const { writeContractAsync: writeUsdc, isMining: isApproving } = useScaffoldWriteContract({
  contractName: "USDC",
  writeContractParams: { mutation: { onMutate: () => redirectToWalletApp(connector?.type) } },
});
```

then drop lines 81 and 99 and the `const tx = ...; await tx` dance — just `await writeUsdc({...})`.

**3. The event feed will get you rate-limited off Base on day one.**
`page.tsx:47-52`. `useScaffoldEventHistory` is explicitly `@deprecated` for production and logs "not optimized for production use… can overload RPC endpoints (especially on L2s)" (`hooks/scaffold-eth/useScaffoldEventHistory.ts:58-60, 100-106`). Default `blocksBatchSize` is 500 and you start at block 33,712,450. Base does ~43,200 blocks/day, so every page load replays the entire gap in **sequential** 500-block `getLogs` pages — thousands of requests, growing daily — and `watch: true` keeps polling at `pollingInterval: 3000`. No dedicated RPC survives that under real traffic, which is probably why `.env.example:15-17` had to grow that scary warning.
Fix: index it. `.agents/skills/ponder/SKILL.md` or `.agents/skills/subgraph/SKILL.md` — this is exactly their use case. If you must ship the hook for v1, bound the window (`fromBlock: latestBlock - 50_000n`) and raise `blocksBatchSize` to something like 10_000 (check your provider's `eth_getLogs` range cap), and label the feed "recent payouts".

**4. Module-scope crash risk + hand-reaching into an autogenerated file.**
`page.tsx:20`

```ts
const PAYOUTS_DEPLOY_BLOCK = BigInt(deployedContracts[8453].Payouts.deployedOnBlock);
```

`deployedContracts.ts:1-4` literally says "autogenerated… do not edit manually". The moment someone runs `yarn deploy` against anything but Base, that key vanishes, TS breaks, and at runtime it throws during module evaluation — a white screen, not a graceful error. It's also **completely unnecessary**: `useScaffoldEventHistory` already defaults `fromBlock` to `deployedOnBlock` (`useScaffoldEventHistory.ts:128-135`).
Fix: delete line 20, delete the `deployedContracts` import on line 9, delete `fromBlock` on line 50.

**5. Wrong-network switch is unusable on mobile and silently swallows rejections.**
`page.tsx:121`: `onClick={() => switchChain({ chainId: targetNetwork.id })}`. Over WalletConnect this also needs the deep link (same problem as #2), and there's no `onError`, so a rejected or unsupported switch leaves the user staring at an unchanged button.
Fix:

```ts
onClick={() =>
  switchChain(
    { chainId: targetNetwork.id },
    { onError: e => notification.error(getParsedError(e)) },
  )
}
```
plus `redirectToWalletApp(connector?.type)` right after the call (or via the hook's mutation options).

### Improvements Needed

**6. Three toasts for one failure.** `page.tsx:84-86` and `104-106` call `notification.error(getParsedError(e))`, but `simulateContractWriteAndNotifyError` already notified and rethrew (`utils/scaffold-eth/contract.ts:420-421`) and so did `useTransactor` (`hooks/scaffold-eth/useTransactor.tsx:107-108`). A rejected signature spams the user. Make the catch `console.error(e)` only.

**7. "Approve USDC" flashes at users who already have allowance.** `page.tsx:69`:

```ts
const needsApproval = parsedAmount === undefined || allowance === undefined || allowance < parsedAmount;
```

`allowance` is `undefined` while loading — and it stays disabled/undefined until `useDeployedContractInfo` finishes its on-chain bytecode check (`useDeployedContractInfo.ts:63-72`), because `payoutsContract?.address` is an arg and the read is gated on no-undefined-args (`useScaffoldReadContract.ts:53`). So on every load the primary CTA says "Approve" for a beat. Impatient user taps it and burns gas on an approval they already had.
Fix: derive `const isAllowanceLoading = allowance === undefined;`, render a disabled loading button while that's true, and make `needsApproval = allowance !== undefined && hasValidAmount && allowance < parsedAmount!`.

**8. Unguarded `payoutsContract?.address` in write args.** `page.tsx:78`. `OptionalTuple` (`utils/scaffold-eth/contract.ts:157`) lets `undefined` typecheck, so TS won't save you — viem will throw something ugly at encode/simulate time. Add `if (!payoutsContract || parsedAmount === undefined) return;` at the top of `handleApprove`.

**9. `isRefreshing` is redundant state that lies about what it does.** `page.tsx:29, 70`. Both write hooks already expose `isMining`. Either drop it and use `isApproving || isPaying`, or at least name it `isSubmitting`. Can we keep this simple?

**10. Raw number input for money.** `page.tsx:175-183`. `type="number"` accepts `1e3` (which `parseUnits` chokes on — you catch it, but the user gets no feedback), gives mobile users the wrong keyboard, and silently rounds anything past 6 decimals. Add `inputMode="decimal"`, and show an inline error when `amount` is non-empty and `parsedAmount === undefined`. Also: nothing checks `parsedAmount > usdcBalance` before enabling Send — the user only finds out when simulation fails. That's a two-line check with a `text-error` hint.

**11. `memo` is unbounded calldata.** `page.tsx:184-189` — a pasted essay is real money in L1 data fees. Add `maxLength` (say 140) and say so in the UI.

**12. Unbounded feed render.** `page.tsx:201` maps every event ever. Slice it (`.slice(0, 25)`) or paginate.

**13. `window.open(href, "_self")` is the fragile form.** `walletRedirect.ts:23` — `window.location.href = href` is more reliable in iOS Safari and in-app browsers. Bigger worry: there's no mobile check, so a **desktop** user connected by QR who has a stale `WALLETCONNECT_DEEPLINK_CHOICE` in localStorage gets their tab navigated to `metamask://` mid-transaction. Gate on a coarse mobile UA / `navigator.maxTouchPoints` check, or on the href being a native scheme you expect.

**14. `manifest.json` is dead weight.** `packages/nextjs/public/manifest.json` exists and was updated, but nothing links it — `utils/scaffold-eth/getMetadata.ts:46-54` only sets `icons`. Add `manifest: "/manifest.json"` to the returned `Metadata`. Related: the task mentions `packages/nextjs/public/favicon.svg` as a new untracked file, but **it is not on disk** — `public/` only contains `favicon.png`, `logo.svg`, `manifest.json`, `thumbnail.jpg`. Either the SVG was lost before commit or the change was abandoned half-done; `getMetadata.ts:47-53` and `manifest.json:5` both still reference `/favicon.png` only.

**15. Leftover empty template literal.** `app/layout.tsx:15`: `<html suppressHydrationWarning className={``}>`. Not a big deal, but it's the kind of thing that makes me wonder what else got half-deleted. Same smell at `components/ScaffoldEthAppWithProviders.tsx:18`.

**16. The cast in wagmiConfig.** `services/web3/wagmiConfig.tsx:22`: `(scaffoldConfig.rpcOverrides as ScaffoldConfig["rpcOverrides"])`. If you need `as`, the types are wrong — it's only needed because `scaffold.config.ts:18-21` builds `rpcOverrides` imperatively then wraps everything in `as const`. Build it as an object literal expression (`...(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_RPC_URL ? { [chains.base.id]: ... } : {})`) and the cast disappears.

**17. `pollingInterval: 3000` plus `watch: true` everywhere.** `scaffold.config.ts:27`. Every `useScaffoldReadContract` invalidates on every new block (`useScaffoldReadContract.ts:72-77`), and Base produces a block every 2s. Balance + allowance + event polling at that cadence is a lot of CU for data that only changes when the user acts. Consider `watch: false` on the two reads and rely on your explicit `refetch` calls — you already do them in `handlePay`.

**18. Solidity nits.** `packages/hardhat/contracts/Payouts.sol:21-23` uses `require` strings; custom errors are cheaper and this is on an L2 where calldata/gas still matters. `pay` is `external`, `usdc` is `immutable` — good stuff. Consider OpenZeppelin `SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom` instead of a hand-rolled bool check (see `.agents/skills/openzeppelin/SKILL.md`); USDC is well-behaved, but the pattern is the pattern.

**19. Deploy script hardcodes Base USDC on every network.** `packages/hardhat/deploy/00_deploy_payouts.ts:4,19`. Deploy to localhost or baseSepolia and you get a `Payouts` pointed at an address with no code — every `pay()` reverts with no useful message. Branch on `env` chain id, or deploy a mock ERC20 for non-Base targets.

### What Works Well

- Moving USDC from `deployedContracts.ts` to `externalContracts.ts` — correct and durable, since the former is regenerated on every deploy. Thanks for this.
- `walletRedirect.ts` — the intent and the comments are genuinely good (fire-after-write, no-op in in-app browsers, don't break the tx on malformed JSON). The idea is right; the connector check and the timing are what's broken.
- Keeping mainnet in `enabledChains` (`wagmiConfig.tsx:11-13`) so ENS still resolves while targeting Base.
- `AddressInput` for the recipient and `Address` with `chain={targetNetwork}` for Base explorer links — exactly the `@scaffold-ui/components` usage I want to see. `RainbowKitCustomConnectButton` from `~~/components/scaffold-eth` is correct too; that one isn't in the library.
- daisyUI throughout — `card card-compact`, `input input-bordered`, `loading loading-spinner`, `btn btn-primary`. No raw Tailwind colors anywhere. Looks great.
- `.env.example:15-17` documenting *why* `NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_RPC_URL` is required, not just that it is. I love this.

### Refactored Version

## assistant
## Overall Assessment

Mostly solid work — the SE-2 hooks are used properly, USDC correctly moved to `externalContracts.ts`, daisyUI throughout, and the inline-error fix landed. But this is **not** ship-ready for mobile or for a Base mainnet event feed. The WalletConnect deep-link helper doesn't fire for the wallets people actually use, the event history hook is the deprecated `getLogs` one pointed at 1M+ Base blocks, and there's a module-level hardcoded `8453` index that white-screens the page if the contract map ever changes. Let's fix those four or five things and this is genuinely nice.

## Critical Issues

**1. The mobile deep link never fires for MetaMask/Rainbow/Ledger — i.e. for almost everyone.**
`/packages/nextjs/utils/scaffold-eth/walletRedirect.ts:14`
```ts
if (connectorId !== "walletConnect") return;
```
RainbowKit builds each wallet via `getWalletConnectConnector`, so `connector.id` is `"metaMask"`, `"rainbow"`, `"ledger"`, `"phantom"`… Only the generic "WalletConnect" tile has id `"walletConnect"`. Every other WC session is silently skipped — exactly the bug this file exists to fix.
Fix: key off the wagmi connector **type**, which is `"walletConnect"` for all of them.
```ts
export const redirectToWalletApp = (connectorType?: string) => {
  if (typeof window === "undefined" || connectorType !== "walletConnect") return;
```
and at the call sites `/packages/nextjs/app/payouts/page.tsx:83` and `:104` pass `connector?.type` instead of `connector?.id`.

**2. The redirect fires before the wallet request exists.**
`/packages/nextjs/app/payouts/page.tsx:79-83` — `useScaffoldWriteContract` awaits `simulateContractWriteAndNotifyError` (`useScaffoldWriteContract.ts:118-124`) before it ever calls `writeContractAsync`. That's a full RPC round trip. So we bounce the user into MetaMask *before* the WC request is published; they stare at an empty wallet, come back, and the prompt shows up behind them. Worse: if simulation reverts (insufficient balance/allowance), we've app-switched them for a transaction that never happens.
Fix: hook the redirect to the mutation start instead of the call site:
```ts
const { writeContractAsync: writeUsdc, isMining: isApproving } = useScaffoldWriteContract({
  contractName: "USDC",
  writeContractParams: { mutation: { onMutate: () => redirectToWalletApp(connector?.type) } },
});
```
Then `await writeUsdc({...})` normally and drop the `const tx = ...; redirect(); await tx;` dance from both handlers.

**3. Wrong-network switch has the same mobile dead-end, plus no error handling.**
`/packages/nextjs/app/payouts/page.tsx:128` — `switchChain({ chainId })` over WalletConnect also needs the app raised, and a rejected/unsupported switch produces zero feedback.
```ts
onClick={() =>
  switchChain(
    { chainId: targetNetwork.id },
    { onError: e => setActionError(getParsedError(e)) },
  )
}
```
with the redirect wired through `useSwitchChain({ mutation: { onMutate: () => redirectToWalletApp(connector?.type) } })`.

**4. Module-level hardcoded chain id can white-screen the page.**
`/packages/nextjs/app/payouts/page.tsx:9,20`
```ts
const PAYOUTS_DEPLOY_BLOCK = BigInt(deployedContracts[8453].Payouts.deployedOnBlock);
```
`deployedContracts.ts` is autogenerated (its own header says don't edit it). Redeploy to Base Sepolia for staging, or run `yarn deploy` on a different net, and this throws at *import* time — the whole route dies, not just the feed. It's also redundant: `useScaffoldEventHistory` already defaults `fromBlock` to `deployedOnBlock` (`useScaffoldEventHistory.ts:128-135`).
Fix: delete lines 9 and 20 and the `fromBlock` prop on line 51.

**5. Event feed will hammer Base and be slow as hell.**
`/packages/nextjs/app/payouts/page.tsx:48-53`. `useScaffoldEventHistory` is explicitly deprecated for non-local chains (`useScaffoldEventHistory.ts:58-60`), defaults to `blocksBatchSize: 500`, and paginates *sequentially*. From block 33,712,450 to Base head is well over a million blocks → thousands of serial `eth_getLogs` calls on every page load, and `watch: true` keeps polling on top of that. Your own `.env.example:15` warns the RPC will fall over — this is the thing that makes it fall over.
Fix (pick one): use the **ponder** or **subgraph** skill for the feed (the right answer for mainnet), or, if you insist on shipping this as-is, at minimum `blocksBatchSize: 50_000` plus a bounded window (`fromBlock: blockNumber - 500_000n`) and drop `watch` in favour of refetching after a successful pay.

## Improvements Needed

**6. "Approve USDC" flashes for users who already have allowance.**
`/packages/nextjs/app/payouts/page.tsx:70`
```ts
const needsApproval = parsedAmount === undefined || allowance === undefined || allowance < parsedAmount;
```
`allowance` is `undefined` while the read is disabled/loading — and it's disabled until `useDeployedContractInfo` finishes its bytecode check (`useScaffoldReadContract.ts:53`, `useDeployedContractInfo.ts:63-72`). So a user with a standing allowance sees "Approve USDC" and may re-approve for nothing. Distinguish loading from "needs approval":
```ts
const isAllowanceLoading = allowance === undefined;
const needsApproval = !isAllowanceLoading && parsedAmount !== undefined && allowance < parsedAmount;
```
…and show a spinner/disabled button while `isAllowanceLoading`.

**7. `approve` can be sent with an `undefined` spender.**
`/packages/nextjs/app/payouts/page.tsx:81` — `args: [payoutsContract?.address, parsedAmount]`. `OptionalTuple` (`utils/scaffold-eth/contract.ts:157`) makes this typecheck, but viem will throw a garbage encoding error if the user clicks before the deployed-contract check resolves. Guard it:
```ts
if (!payoutsContract || parsedAmount === undefined) return;
```
in `handleApprove`.

**8. `isRefreshing` is lying to us.**
`/packages/nextjs/app/payouts/page.tsx:29,71` — it's set for the entire submit lifecycle, not a refresh. And `isApproving`/`isPaying` from the hooks already cover the mining window. Rename to `isSubmitting`, or drop it and derive `isBusy` from the hook flags plus a single local `isSubmitting`. Not a big deal, but the name cost me a minute.

**9. Shared busy/error state across two actions.**
Same file, line 71: `isBusy` disables both buttons and `actionError` (line 206) isn't cleared when the user switches network, disconnects, or edits the form. Clear it in the input `onChange` handlers at least.

**10. Raw `<input type="number">` for money.**
`/packages/nextjs/app/payouts/page.tsx:182-190`. `type="number"` accepts `1e5` and locale commas (your try/catch swallows those into "button disabled, no explanation"), and gives no `inputMode="decimal"` on mobile. SE-2 ships `IntegerInput`/`EtherInput` from `@scaffold-ui/components`; for 6-decimal USDC the honest minimum is `inputMode="decimal"` plus a visible "Enter a valid amount" hint when `amount && !hasValidAmount`. Also: no balance check — `hasValidAmount` doesn't compare against `usdcBalance`, so the user only learns at simulate time.

**11. Unbounded feed render.** Line 210 maps every `Paid` event ever. Slice it (`.slice(0, 25)`) or paginate.

**12. Solidity: require strings instead of custom errors.**
`/packages/hardhat/contracts/Payouts.sol:21-23`. You know the drill:
```solidity
error ZeroRecipient();
error ZeroAmount();
error TransferFailed();
```
Cheaper, and `getParsedErrorWithAllAbis` decodes them nicely in the UI. Security-wise the contract is fine — `transferFrom(msg.sender, ...)` can't be abused, no reentrancy surface, `immutable usdc`. Good.

**13. Deploy script hardcodes Base USDC on every network.**
`/packages/hardhat/deploy/00_deploy_payouts.ts:4` — deploy to localhost and `Payouts` points at an address with no code; every `pay()` reverts with an opaque error. Gate it: mock ERC20 on chain 31337, real address on 8453.

**14. Manifest is never served.** `/packages/nextjs/public/manifest.json` exists and was rebranded, but `getMetadata` (`/packages/nextjs/utils/scaffold-eth/getMetadata.ts:46-54`) only sets `icons`. Add `manifest: "/manifest.json"` or delete the file. Also `/packages/nextjs/app/layout.tsx:15` still has the leftover empty `className={``}` — drop it.

**15. Note:** `packages/nextjs/public/favicon.svg` shows as untracked in the status I was given but **does not exist on disk**, while `getMetadata.ts:49` and `manifest.json:5` both reference `/favicon.png`. Make sure the intended icon actually got committed.

## What Works Well

- Moving USDC to `externalContracts.ts:14-104` is exactly right — it's not our deployment, it shouldn't live in an autogenerated file. Thanks for this.
- `Address`/`AddressInput` from `@scaffold-ui/components` (page.tsx:4), daisyUI classes everywhere, no raw Tailwind colours. Good stuff.
- All reads go through `useScaffoldReadContract`/`useSelectedNetwork`, so they stay on Base even when the wallet is on the wrong chain. Correct by construction.
- `rpcOverrides` for Base plus the honest `.env.example:15-17` warning — I love this approach, someone actually thought about production RPC.
- The guarded `parseUnits` (page.tsx:60-66) and the comment explaining *why*. That's the kind of comment I want.
- Dropping the duplicate `notification.error` for inline `actionError` (page.tsx:86-89) — right call, `useTransactor.tsx:107` and `simulateContractWriteAndNotifyError` already toast.

Let's discuss the event feed — I'd really rather see ponder there than a thousand `eth_getLogs` calls. What do you think?

## assistant
The review came back with real findings. I verified each one rather than taking them at face value, applied what held up, and committed as `5316c17`.

**Confirmed and fixed:**

- **The mobile deep link fired too early.** `useScaffoldWriteContract` awaits `simulateContractWriteAndNotifyError` before it ever touches the wallet, so my call-site redirect bounced the user into their wallet a full RPC round trip before the request was published — and app-switched them for nothing when simulation reverted. Now wired to the mutation's `onMutate`.
- **`deployedContracts[8453].Payouts.deployedOnBlock` at module scope** would have thrown at *import* time — a white screen, not a degraded feed — the moment a deploy targeted another chain. Deleted; it was redundant anyway.
- **The event feed would have been brutal.** `useScaffoldEventHistory` is explicitly deprecated for L2s, paginates sequentially at 500 blocks, and I'd pointed it at the deploy block — ~18M Base blocks, so tens of thousands of serial `eth_getLogs` calls per page load. Now bounded to ~100k blocks at 10k batch size with a pinned `fromBlock`.
- **"Approve USDC" flashed at users who already had allowance** while the read was still loading — a real risk of burning gas on a redundant approval. Now a distinct loading state.
- Wrong-network switch had no `onError` and no deep link; unguarded `payoutsContract?.address` in the approve args (`OptionalTuple` lets `undefined` typecheck, so viem would throw at encode time); no balance check before enabling Send; unbounded memo and feed render; `manifest.json` was never linked from metadata.

**One finding I checked and rejected:** the reviewer said `connector.id` is `"metaMask"`/`"rainbow"` for RainbowKit's WalletConnect wallets, so my check skipped almost everyone. That's not right — RainbowKit's `createWalletConnectConnector` spreads only `{ rkDetails }`, so `id` stays `"walletConnect"`; only the *injected* path rewrites `id`. My original check did fire. I switched to `connector.type` anyway, since that's the field that actually means "signs in another app" and it costs nothing.

**Deliberately not done:**

- **Migrating the feed to Ponder.** The reviewer pushed for this and it is the correct long-term answer, but it's a new service, deploy target and ops surface — a scope call for you, not something to slip into a QA pass three days from ship. The bounded window makes the current approach survivable in the meantime.
- **Solidity custom errors** and **the deploy script hardcoding Base USDC on every network** (deploy to localhost and every `pay()` reverts opaquely). Both are fair, neither is a ship blocker, and touching the contract means redeploying.
- The reviewer flagged the duplicate `notification.error` and a missing `favicon.svg`; both were already resolved before it finished reading — the errors are inline now precisely because `useTransactor` already toasts, and the SVG was intentionally deleted as an unreferenced duplicate of `logo.svg`.

`yarn lint`, `yarn format` and `yarn next:check-types` are clean. The pre-existing `/_not-found` prerender failure in `yarn next:build` is still there, unchanged from the baseline commit.

**The blocker from my last message still stands and is the thing to act on:** there is no contract code at the Payouts address on Base. None of the above matters until that's deployed and `deployedContracts.ts` is regenerated.
